summary: Two-slice follow-on (foundation→properties): W1 documents additive availableStock on LookupResponse in OpenAPI only; W2 depends_on W1 and extends OCL, Vitest, and implementation so authorized lookup returns availableStock while UnauthorizedError / PreconditionError failure channels stay checkable without mutation.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Lookup availableStock covers authorized success and preserved named failures
  Given the inventory reservation service for clients
  When clients exercise authorized soft-hold lookup by id, missing or not-visible lookup, and unauthorized lookup
  Then authorized lookup returns holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, and current availableStock for that hold's SKU without mutating stock or holds
  And missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookups fail with PreconditionError and UnauthorizedError respectively without mutation
  And openapi/openapi.yaml documents additive availableStock on LookupResponse while prior reserve/release/expire/lookup operations and required hold fields remain
  And contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover success with availableStock and named UnauthorizedError / PreconditionError failures
  And payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, TTL extend, list-by-SKU aggregates, and a separate stock-query endpoint are not required
